text: Zelensky says the US floated NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for ceding the Donbas. The claim is Zelensky's; no US confirmation is recorded in the tracker. It follows US envoys meeting Putin in the Kremlin on 12 Nov.

judge.comment: Attributed claim of a sensitive diplomatic nature; wording keeps it as Zelensky's assertion. Human check advised before publishing.

factChecks.claim: Zelensky says US floated NATO membership for ceding Donbas
No US confirmation recorded in tracker
US envoys met Putin in the Kremlin on 12 Nov

text: How many of Lebanon's dead were fighters? Lebanon's health ministry counts 4,386 dead since 2 March, with no combatant split. Israel puts Hezbollah dead at roughly 1,700-2,500. Hezbollah publishes no totals. No figure reconciles the three.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed with tracker figures; the health-ministry as-of date is not stated beyond 'cumulative since 2 March', so a human should confirm before publishing.

factChecks.claim: Lebanese Ministry of Public Health: 4,386 killed, cumulative since 2 March, no civilian/combatant split

text: How much Russian refining capacity is actually down? Ukraine's General Staff said 42.74% in July. The IEA said losses were "more than 20%" at peak. Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%, as undamaged refineries offset losses.

judge.comment: Three attributed figures from the tracker's unresolved-dispute record, no adjudication.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%
